validity.researcher_notes: The line is real and correctly classified. Ukrtransgaz lists «Єлець - Курськ – Київ» as put into service in 1982, and a later entry, Kursk to Kyiv, in 1985. It is not a duplicate of P0775 (see that row). Two problems. The start year on the sheet is 1981 and two sources say 1982. The length of 297 km has no source: the VTG table gives Kursk to Kyiv alone as 507 km, and the drawn route is about 607 km, so 297 looks too short for Yelets to Kyiv. The owner entry shows Gazprom at 100.00% beside a second owner, which is the owner-notation question for Baird.

fills.researcher_notes: No source dated 2024 or later was found that says this line is in use. The Kursk regional government page (archived December 2022) and the Gazprom Kursk compressor-station page (archived May 2025) both list the line, but only as part of the corridor's history. Russian transit through Ukraine stopped on 1 January 2025. Searched Russian and Ukrainian news, the Ukrainian operator site is blocked (HTTP 403).
